property_summary: After depositing 1 wei as alice, calling refund() from alice should succeed (not revert) in the reference contract, but the buggy contract's deposit() has already reverted so the balance is 0 and refund() works fine—actually the divergence is that after a call to deposit() the reference contract accepts the deposit while the buggy one reverts, observable by the revert status of the deposit call.
change_summary: Replace assert with require(false) to cause deposit to always revert
